in_sanskrit.name: Nushrratt
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of power and good governance
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nushrratt एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Nushrratt is derived from the Sanskrit words 'nushasan' (good governance) and 'rat' (ruler). This name represents a powerful leader, a just ruler, and a protector. It is believed to bring prosperity and strength to the one who bears this name.
